howto.title: How to play
howto.subtitle: A quick guide to playing and creating a quest
howto.play1Text: Choose a quest and tap “Create game” — a game code appears
howto.play2Text: Participants enter the code on their phones and join the game
howto.play3Text: Click tiles on the board — everyone sees the question
howto.play4Text: Players tap the button on their phone. The first one answers, the rest wait
howto.play5Text: Mark “Correct” or “Wrong” — the score updates automatically
howto.create1Text: On the selection page, tap “Create a new quest.”
howto.create2Text: Enter a name and pick the grid size: categories × questions
howto.create3Text: Click tiles and add the question, answer and, if you like, a photo or audio
howto.create4Text: Everything saves automatically — come back and start the game
